column1: # the CONTRACT: which Guard is owned by which crate, at which admission Mode.
# THIS file is the IMPL-BINDING: where the guard lives in the crate src + the
# test that proves it. The gate scripts/hygiene/check-adr-081-guards.sh
# cross-checks BOTH: every MANDATORY matrix row whose owner-crate is in the
# workspace MUST have a binding row here, and the binding's impl/test regexes
# MUST match in that crate's src.
# When a new guard-owner crate is admitted (e.g. nika-input M2.4 Guards 1+2),
# the gate goes RED until a binding row is added here AND the guard is
# implemented + tested — the structural forcing function per ADR-081
# "MANDATORY-at-admission". Do NOT pre-fill rows for crates not yet in the
# workspace; the gate auto-discovers the requirement from owed ∩ present.
# - impl_regex : ERE that MUST match in crates/<crate>/src/**.rs (the guard symbol).
# - test_regex : ERE that MUST match a test fn in crates/<crate>/src/**.rs.
